profile.org_note: Family-owned, founder-led company run from El Paso by the Bombach family through Saratoga Homes, Inc. plus market LLCs (Saratoga Homes of Texas Houston, Austin and San Antonio, Saratoga Homes Northeast, Saratoga Homes Horizon) co-managed by C David and Carlos D. Bombach, an affiliated JNC Development, Inc. and an in-house broker JNC Mortgage Company. No land, finance or division executives are published; land and capital decisions appear to sit with the family officers.
profile.summary: Saratoga Homes is a family-owned El Paso entry-level/first-move-up builder founded in 1983 by David Bombach, now selling in El Paso, Houston (north and south), Austin and Killeen (it is not Houston-headquartered; its corporate office is 12300 Montwood Dr., El Paso). It is a conventional for-sale production builder of Builder 100 scale (rank 80 in 2026 per the project spine), owns a captive development entity (JNC Development) and mortgage broker (JNC Mortgage), and finances through Texas and regional banks rather than public debt; inactive-looking New Mexico and Illinois entities and a San Antonio LLC suggest past or planned markets. A plausible land-banking prospect, with all land and capital authority concentrated in the Bombach family.

people.note: Verification 2026-11-19: the CEO title is stated only by Builder's firm page (archived 2025-10-11, 'CEO C. David Bombach'), so tagged Reported; the company's Our Story page (https://www.saratogahomestexas.com/about/our-story/, modified 2026-01-09) supports 'Founder' only, and the Texas Comptroller record (2024) supports Chairman and Director. A 2026 Builder 100 firm listing (builderonline.com/?p=111613, 695 closings) seen only in a search snippet also names him CEO. Our Story names him Founder (company founded 1983; Vietnam-era Army veteran); the company's NewHomeSource builder profile calls him 'CEO of Saratoga Homes' and Builder's firm page (seen in search snippet, builderonline.com 403) lists 'C. David Bombach' as CEO. Texas records list C David Bombach as Chairman and Director of Saratoga Homes, Inc. (2024) and of JNC Development, Inc. (2026), President of JNC Mortgage Company (2024), with a Katy (Houston-area) address. Our Story says sons Charlie and Jack 'continue to build' the company, so day-to-day leadership may have passed to them.
